findings.correction: Keep the hike wording and add a brief footnote that Mount Beimang is a burial mountain and ‘hiking it’ means being dead.
findings.current: If my reaction had been even a moment slower, I would have been hiking up Mount Beimang by now.
findings.defect: Death idiom is left as a literal mountain hike with no cue or footnote, so the meaning (he would already be dead) is not recoverable.
findings.rationale: Binding footnote rules cover this historical/idiom image; continuity already treats Beimang as a death expression.
findings.source: 잠깐이라도 반응이 늦었다면 지금쯤 북망산을 등산하고 있었을 거다.

findings.correction: Keep goshiwon and footnote it as a tiny, cheap room-for-rent.
findings.current: I didn’t even know the names of all the people living in my goshiwon.
findings.defect: 고시원 is kept untranslated with no footnote.
findings.rationale: The translation rules explicitly require a goshiwon footnote at first meaningful use.
findings.source: 같은 고시원 주민들 이름도 다 모르는데 고작 며칠 본 NPC 따위.

findings.correction: Even rotten, it’s still a junichi, I suppose—with a short footnote that a decayed quality fish is still a quality fish.
findings.current: *The Jin Family of Taiyuan… Even a fallen tree can still bear fruit, I suppose.*
findings.defect: Replaces the fish proverb (even rotten, still a junichi: fallen stock still shows quality) with a different tree/fruit proverb.
findings.rationale: Semantic fidelity forbids swapping the source’s proverb image for a neater English one.

findings.correction: Watching Jin Taekyung smack his lips in regret
findings.current: Watching Jin Taekyung click his tongue in regret, Jopil felt a surge of fury.
findings.defect: 입맛을 다시다 (smacking his lips over the missed finish) is changed to clicking his tongue, a different gesture already used for Jopil earlier.
findings.rationale: Altered physical action and insolent characterization before Jopil’s rage.
findings.source: 입맛을 다시는 진태경을 보며 조필은 극렬한 분노를 느꼈다.

findings.correction: But I was a step too late. Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop, who had come running with everything they had, thrust their weapons at Jopil, who was distracted by me.
findings.current: But they were too late. Hyuk Mujin and Han Yeop had charged forward with all their strength and thrust their weapons at Jopil, who was distracted by me.
findings.defect: Subject of 한발 늦었다 is shifted onto Hyuk and Han Yeop, who do land the attack; the late party is Taekyung’s failed stop.
findings.rationale: Category-1 subject/causal error: they are not the ones who arrived too late.
findings.source: 그러나 한발 늦었다. 온 힘을 다해 달려온 혁무진과 한엽이 … 병장기를 찔러 넣었다.

findings.defect: 이 새끼들아 is panicked vulgar abuse of subordinates, softened to ‘idiots’.
findings.rationale: Rules forbid sanitizing profanity; this is a register drop, not a gloss.

findings.correction: Lightning crossed my whole body. The blade stabbed my shoulder, slashed my knee, and pierced my flank before coming back out with a spray of blood.
findings.current: The blade stabbed my shoulder and knee, slashed my flank, and pierced through my body before emerging with a spray of blood.
findings.defect: Maps two stabs onto shoulder and knee, then adds a through-body pierce beyond the three named sites; also drops 번갯불이 전신을 가로질렀다.
findings.rationale: Changes the injury pattern from three sites to an extra impalement.
findings.source: 어깨와 무릎, 옆구리를 쑤시고 베고 꿰뚫은 검신은 핏물과 함께 빠져나왔다.

findings.correction: *Skrrrng.* Jopil’s sword was faster than my spear. The blood-slick crimson blade pushed my spear shaft aside and slipped inward.
findings.current: *Kaaang!* Jopil’s sword was faster than my spear. The blood-red blade pushed my spear shaft aside and slipped inward.
findings.defect: 카가가각 is a grind/scrape along the shaft, rendered as a ringing clash; 피를 머금은 (blood-laden) becomes mere color.
findings.rationale: The sound and blood on the blade are the mechanics of the parry that lets the cut in.
findings.source: 카가가각. 내 창보다 조필의 검이 더 빨랐다. 피를 머금은 붉은 칼날이 창대를 밀어 내며 안쪽으로 파고든다.

findings.current: “Let’s see if you can withstand this, too.”
findings.defect: Completes an intentionally unfinished conditional threat.
findings.rationale: Preserve the dangling 버티면; do not add ‘let’s see’.

findings.correction: a rootless wandering martial artist like that Mount Heng Sword Sect brat or Black Mountain Blade
findings.current: a rootless wandering martial artist like the Mount Heng brat or Black Mountain Blade
findings.defect: Established organization name 항산검문 is cut down to ‘Mount Heng’.
findings.rationale: Glossary binds 항산검문 to Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.source: 항산검문의 애새끼나 흑산도처럼 근본 없는 낭인

findings.correction: Ten-odd zhang vanished in two steps.
findings.current: More than ten zhang vanished in two steps.
findings.defect: 십여 is ten-odd/about ten, not ‘more than ten’.
findings.source: 십여 장의 거리가 두 걸음 만에 사라진다.

findings.defect: Sarcastic ‘would I be all right?’ is changed into a question about appearance.
findings.rationale: 괜찮겠냐 answers 괜찮으십니까, not how he looked.

findings.correction: *Splat.* He planted his face in the ground, which had only just begun to thaw.
findings.current: *Splurt.* He planted his face in the ground, which had only just begun to thaw.
findings.defect: 철퍽 is the wet thud of a face hitting thawing earth, not a blood splurt.
findings.rationale: Wrong SFX type beside an intact action.
findings.source: 철퍽. 이제 막 녹기 시작한 땅에 그가 얼굴을 박았다.

findings.correction: They crashed into trees, fountains of blood bursting from them.
findings.current: They crashed into trees, fountains of blood bursting from their mouths.
findings.defect: Adds ‘from their mouths’; source only has blood fountaining after chest blows.
findings.rationale: Do not specify an unstated bleed site.
findings.source: 그들은 피 분수를 뿜으며 나무에 처박혔다.

summary: Action, subject, injury, proverb, and register errors, plus missing required cultural notes; System/glossary hits in QA are mostly false leads.
